goal: Add a governed, recoverable archive command for old durable reviewer verdicts so the verdict namespace stays under its 1000-ref listing ceiling, and make reviewer assignment name the ceiling as the real cause instead of reporting leases as unreadable.
dispatcher: Claude shared-db coordinator session for issue 2987
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, preview, production, claim or marker mutation.
No hand deletion of verdict refs and no bypass of the review mutex.
No edits to scripts/check-dispatch-collision.mjs, scripts/orchestrator-snapshot.mjs or scripts/check-migration-pr-lease.mjs.
assumptions: Verdicts of merged PRs that touched supabase/migrations must stay live because production promotion re-runs the exact-head approval check on the merged source PR.
Archiving moves a verdict ref under refs/db-review-archived-verdicts, so every archived verdict is recoverable.

Generation 2 follows the governed review of PR #2992 at f1c27105 (REVISE, High: pull request states must be re-read under the mutex); the fix is a later implementation commit, so the evidence pair is republished after it.
stop_conditions: Stop if archiving would remove a verdict needed by an active reviewer lease, an open PR or a merged migration PR.
Stop if the archive cannot run under the review mutex with compare-and-swap readback.
